items.headline: Dwayne McDougle's pick-6 turns game Nebraska's way in a 48-23 victory over Maryland
items.description: — Dwayne McDougle III's 81-yard interception return for a touchdown sparked Nebraska in the first half, and the Cornhuskers all but shut down Maryland after that in a penalty-filled 48-23 victory Saturday.

items.headline: Squarely on hot seat, Maryland's Locksley set for Nebraska
items.description: In his weekly availability Tuesday, Maryland coach Mike Locksley, who was already in the hot-seat discussion before the season began, told reporters his "focus has been on getting us ready to play up at Lincoln," referring to Saturday's date vs. Nebraska.
